list_name.description: The name of the mailing list or archive source

archive_home.description: The directory where the archive resides

archive_home_url.description: The URL for the home page of the archive

archive_index_url.description: The URL for the main index file

index_subject.description: The subject of the main index file

user_agent.description: The user agent string to send when fetching external resources

date_format.description: The date format for displayed dates

timezone.description: The time zone for displayed dates

admin_email.description: The email address for the list owner/admin

author_name.description: The name of the person or entity responsible for the archive

show_from.description: Whether to include the 'From' field in the index

show_subject.description: Whether to include the 'Subject' field in the index

num_per_page.description: The number of messages to display per page in the index

stylesheet.description: The style sheet to use for the archive

resource_dir.description: The name of the resource directory for custom resources

subject_link.description: Whether to link messages by subject

compress_index.description: Whether to compress the index files

ignore_patterns.description: List of regular expressions for messages to ignore (items: string pattern to ignore)

include_patterns.description: List of regular expressions for messages to include (items: string pattern to include)
